value.rationale: Determines a natural strictly harder Waring-type invariant for a prime-field multiplicative subgroup: every exceptional prime, every missing residue at those primes, and the sharp first persistent covering prime 131. The distinction is mathematically substantive at p=71 and 101, where ordinary two-summand Waring holds but restricted covering fails. The genus-six proof and finite census form a reusable template.
